desc:
👚👖Mix and match random UGC to create your ultimate look! 🛍️ Try on & shop the catalog! 

👋Welcome to "Would you rather: Dress Up Avatar🧢🎀 "

🏃 Run through the course
🚪 Go through gates to pick items
👗 Put them on
💾 Save your look
📸 Take photos
📱 Share it
🛒 Buy it if you love it!

🏁 Try creating outfits for various themes!
🔍️ Find your favorite UGC!
🔄 Dress up as many times as you like
😊 Let's communicate with stamps!

----------
👀 You can try out marketplace items, emotes, and more.
🙆‍♂️ UGC purchased in-game can also be worn in other experiences.
➕️Roblox Plus subscribers earn 1.5x more coins.

----------
👍️ Tap the "Like" button!
⭐️ Add to your favorites!
👥 Join our community!
💬 Leave your thoughts in the feedback comments!
📹️ Record and post to Moments!
💪 New updates coming soon!

[Latest updates]
🎃 The lobby got a Halloween theme 🍭
📖 Top shared photos will hit magazines and billboards!
